Art_Restricted_Shelf_Access.title: Restricted Shelf Access
Art_Restricted_Shelf_Access.rule_text: The restricted shelf access article covers unauthorized entry into a restricted archive shelf area and carries an archive warning.

Art_Relic_Handling_Breach.title: Relic Handling Breach
Art_Relic_Handling_Breach.rule_text: The relic handling breach article covers restricted shelf access combined with handling of a fragile relic and carries reading room suspension.

Art_Catalog_Alteration.title: Catalog Alteration
Art_Catalog_Alteration.rule_text: The catalog alteration article covers restricted shelf access combined with interference in locked catalog records and carries conservation quarantine.

Art_Vault_Removal.title: Vault Removal
Art_Vault_Removal.rule_text: The vault removal article covers relic handling followed by removal toward the archive exit and carries permanent archive exclusion.

Art_Curator_Order_Authorization.title: Curator Order Authorization
Art_Curator_Order_Authorization.rule_text: The curator order authorization article covers relic handling supported by complete curator order records and carries no criminal liability.

Art_Flood_Rescue_Authorization.title: Flood Rescue Authorization
Art_Flood_Rescue_Authorization.rule_text: The flood rescue authorization article covers restricted shelf conduct supported by complete flood rescue records and carries no criminal liability.

rules.name: entry_facts_imply_unauthorized_stack_entry
rules.natural_text: Unauthorized stack entry is present if any one of the following occurs: a person enters a closed stack, uses an unregistered reader card, or bypasses the reading-room desk.

rules.name: shelf_facts_imply_restricted_shelf_status
rules.natural_text: Restricted shelf status is present when the shelf is marked restricted and no curator is present.

rules.name: handling_facts_imply_fragile_relic_handling
rules.natural_text: Fragile relic handling is present when the relic is tagged fragile and any one of the following occurs: the person touches it without gloves, lifts it from its cradle, or places it under a lamp.

rules.name: catalog_facts_imply_catalog_record_interference
rules.natural_text: Catalog record interference is present when the catalog lock is active and any one of the following occurs: the person changes an entry, deletes a condition note, or swaps an archive label.

rules.name: exit_facts_imply_vault_exit_step
rules.natural_text: A vault exit step is present when the exit alarm is active and any one of the following occurs: the person carries the relic past the blue line, seals it in a private case, or leaves with an archive box.

rules.name: curator_facts_imply_curator_authorization_records
rules.natural_text: Curator authorization records are complete when there is a written curator order, the order names the relic, and the handling time is logged.

rules.name: flood_facts_imply_flood_rescue_records
rules.natural_text: Flood rescue records are complete when a flood alarm sounds, the item is moved to a dry room, and a rescue note is filed.

rules.name: entry_and_shelf_imply_restricted_shelf_violation
rules.natural_text: A restricted shelf violation is established by unauthorized stack entry into a restricted shelf area.

rules.name: shelf_and_handling_imply_relic_handling_violation
rules.natural_text: A relic handling violation is established when a restricted shelf violation is combined with fragile relic handling.

rules.name: shelf_and_catalog_imply_catalog_alteration_violation
rules.natural_text: A catalog alteration violation is established when a restricted shelf violation is combined with catalog record interference.

rules.name: handling_and_exit_imply_vault_removal_basis
rules.natural_text: Vault removal is established when a relic handling violation is followed by a vault exit step.

rules.name: handling_and_curator_imply_curator_order_authorization
rules.natural_text: Curator order authorization is established when relic handling is supported by complete curator authorization records.

rules.name: shelf_and_flood_imply_flood_rescue_authorization
rules.natural_text: Flood rescue authorization is established when restricted shelf conduct is supported by complete flood rescue records.
